title: RoleAssignmentChange
description: Request to assign or remove one domain-scoped role for one pseudonymous principal (PRP-39 identity API). Maps onto PRP-06 PolicyRoleAssignment: assign upserts the assignment with assignment_id, remove deletes it. Privileged roles (admin, security_auditor) must carry expires_at, as PolicyRoleAssignment requires; there is no tenant-wide, wildcard or permanent privileged form. The caller's identity and permission come from the server-derived IdentityScope, never from this body. Rules JSON Schema cannot express (expires_at is in the future) are enforced by the PRP-39 handler.

op.description: assign: create or replace the assignment (role and domain_ids required). remove: delete it (role and domain_ids optional, echoed for audit).

domain_ids.description: Domains the role applies to. At least one; there is no tenant-wide form.

expires_at.description: When the assignment lapses. Required for admin and security_auditor.
